meta.title: AVATAR LIVE — Your VRChat avatar, straight to your stream
meta.description: A Windows app that lets you use your VRChat avatar as it is for streaming, screen sharing and video creation, without VRM conversion. Your original shaders, PhysBones, Expressions menu and face tracking, just as they are.

features.title: The avatar you know from VRChat, just as it is.
features.sub: No need to rebuild anything. Everything built into your avatar moves just as it is.

items.title: No VRM conversion
items.body: Export once from your avatar project and you're done. If you change the avatar, just export it again.

items.title: Your original shaders
items.body: Shows the shaders on your avatar, such as Poiyomi and lilToon, just as they are.

items.title: PhysBones and menus as they are
items.body: Swaying hair, outfit toggles, even expression buttons move with the same settings as in VRChat.

items.title: From face to full body
items.body: Expressions, gaze, finger joints and even full body with a single webcam. Mix in an iPhone and VMC (full-body trackers · gloves) part by part.

items.title: Keyboard · mouse hand motion
items.body: Even when your hands are out of view, the avatar's hands move with your typing and mouse. The characters you type are not recorded.

items.title: Streaming and screen sharing
items.body: Send a transparent background to OBS, and the game and your avatar on one screen to Discord.

how.title: Three steps for VRChat avatars. Direct import for VRM.

steps.title: Open your Unity project
steps.body: Open the Unity project (2022.3.22f1) of the avatar you upload to VRChat.

steps.title: Export with the Exporter
steps.body: Create a .vavatar file with a single click in Curious Bobby - Avatar Exporter.

steps.title: Start in AVATAR LIVE
steps.body: Open the file and turn on your webcam, and your avatar moves right away. From then on, you don't need Unity.

how.note: VRM 0.x and 1.0 files can be opened directly without Unity. A Unity project is needed to export a VRChat avatar as .vavatar, but .vrca files cannot be opened directly.

showcase.title: Everything you need to stream, in one place.

rows.title: Pick an avatar and start
rows.body: Choose a recently used avatar, or drag and drop a file. Lighting and camera are remembered for each avatar.

rows.title: Your Expressions menu as it is
rows.body: Press the same menu you used in VRChat. Items you use often can become buttons or hotkeys.

rows.title: Tracking that fits your face
rows.body: Make the expressions as guided, and the tracking automatically adjusts to fit your face.

rows.title: Pull it, pose it
rows.body: Grab hair or a tail with the mouse and pull, then pose it in exactly the shape you like.

rows.title: To OBS and call apps
rows.body: Send a transparent background over Spout2, and appear on Discord · Zoom through the virtual camera.

rows.title: Game + avatar to Discord
rows.body: Share the game screen with your avatar on top, without OBS. Your friends see the game and your avatar, and you see only the game.

rows.title: Lighting and camera
rows.body: Change the mood with a single preset, and adjust each light's color · angle · range right in the view.

rows.title: DLC room packs
rows.body: Buy extra rooms on BOOTH, and one order number adds them to your room list. Each room brings its own lighting and mood.
points: 13 rooms, such as a Japanese alley, classrooms and a pool

broadcast.title: Viewers and friends move your avatar.
broadcast.sub: Throw objects, pour water and change the lights in response to Twitch, CHZZK and SOOP events and to reactions from Discord friends. It is a Pro feature, currently in beta.

items.title: Simple setup
items.body: Pick an event and a reaction from lists to make one line, such as a throw for a follow or a splash of water for a donation of 10,000 won or more.

items.title: Throw · Liquid · Falling
items.body: Objects fly in and hit, liquid runs down the body, and a hard hit knocks the avatar down before it gets up again.

items.title: Reactions from Discord friends
items.body: Friends who are not watching the stream can move your avatar too, with buttons and the /react command in a Discord channel.

items.title: Node editor
items.body: Connect event, condition and action nodes with lines to build reactions more complex than Simple setup allows.

broadcast.discord: Add the Avatar Live app to your Discord server or group DM. The app asks only for command permissions, and a connect code links it to your channel.

items.q: Can I use my VRChat avatar as it is?
items.a: Yes. Export it with the Exporter from the Unity project you upload to VRChat, and the Expressions menu works just as in VRChat — right down to your outfit and accessory toggles. Shaders and PhysBones come along as they are.

items.q: Do I need a Unity project?
items.a: You can load VRM 0.x and 1.0 files directly without Unity. To export a VRChat avatar as .vavatar, you need its Unity project (2022.3.22f1), but you won't need Unity to use the exported file.

items.q: Can I use just a VRM file?
items.a: Yes. Avatar Live directly imports VRM 0.x and 1.0 files. Some VRM 0.x models that use unsupported shaders may not load.
Your avatar's own shaders are shown as they are. We have tested more than 200 shaders, including Poiyomi and lilToon.

items.q: Can I screen share on Discord without OBS?
items.a: Yes. Turn on screen share and choose 'Avatar Live Share Output' in Discord, and the game and your avatar are shared together.

items.q: What's the difference between Basic and Pro?
items.a: Basic is the edition for personal use (including private Discord sharing with friends), and Pro is for streaming, publishing videos and commercial use. Pro offers 4K output, no watermark, posing, the pose library, objects, broadcast integration and the node editor.

items.q: Can my avatar react to viewer events?
items.a: Yes. Connect Twitch, CHZZK or SOOP in Pro, and events such as follows, donations and channel points can throw objects, pour liquid, change the lights and more. Broadcast integration is in beta, so if something goes wrong, let us know with the app's error report.

items.q: Can my Discord friends move my avatar too?
items.a: Yes. Add the Avatar Live app to your Discord server or group DM and link the channel with a connect code, and your friends can send reactions with buttons or the /react command. It works only while your Avatar Live is running.

items.q: Can I use DLC rooms with Basic?
items.a: Yes. DLC rooms bought on BOOTH work with Basic too. Enter the order number in Settings → License → Enter another code, and they appear in the room list. The built-in rooms and room piece editing are Pro features.
